items.title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
items.summary: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.
